summary_en: FY8/26 annual dividend raised to ¥35/share from ¥30/share (¥5 increase). Full-year payout now ¥35/share, with dividend contingent on shareholder approval at the November 2026 annual meeting.
title_en: Notice of Dividend Forecast Revision (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: Saizeriya Co., Ltd. announced on 15 July 2026 that its board of directors has resolved to revise upward the dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending August 2026. The company increased the annual dividend per share from the previously announced ¥30 to ¥35, representing a ¥5 increase. The rationale cited is that the company views profit distribution to shareholders as a key management priority and, after comprehensively considering recent earnings trends, financial condition, and future business development, determined that a stable and continuous dividend policy supports this objective. The dividend payment is conditional on approval of a surplus distribution proposal at the 54th annual general meeting of shareholders scheduled for November 2026.
